agendas.name: Sally Forth
agendas.description: At battle end, each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit wholly within the opponent's deployment zone gains 2XP. If 3+ units qualify, gain +1 Chivalric Quest tally.

agendas.name: Break Their Will
agendas.description: At battle end, if more than half of opponent's units are destroyed, Below Half-strength, or Battle-shocked, select up to 3 non-destroyed IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units for 2XP each. If all opponent units qualify, gain +1 Chivalric Quest tally.

agendas.name: Petitioned for Aid
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects a No Man's Land objective. Each turn you control it, select one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in range for 1XP. At battle end, if you control it with no enemy within 6", gain +1 Chivalric Quest tally.

agendas.name: Honour Must Be Satisfied
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects one of their MONSTER, VEHICLE, or CHARACTER units. If destroyed by an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in melee, the destroyer gains 2XP. If destroyed by round 3, gain +1 Chivalric Quest tally.

agendas.name: Death Before Dishonour
agendas.description: Only available if Dishonoured or you have Burden units. Pre-game: select one unit. Completed if it: destroys 3+ enemy units, destroys the enemy WARLORD, or ends on a controlled objective in the opponent's deployment zone. On success: 3XP, remove 1 Burden. If the WARLORD, the force is no longer Dishonoured and may swear a new Quest.
